meta.description: ODCONS PROJECTS develops and delivers integrated solutions across agriculture, fisheries, aquaculture, horticulture and sustainable rural development.

hero.subtitle: From rain-fed fields to inland waters, ODCONS PROJECTS builds practical, climate-resilient systems across agriculture, fisheries, aquaculture, horticulture and rural livelihoods.

intro.body: ODCONS PROJECTS operates at the intersection of agriculture, the blue economy, precision technology, agri-infrastructure and community resilience. We engineer holistic, scalable solutions that empower smallholder farmers, fishing communities and institutional partners across India.
intro.visionQuote: "Engineering better outcomes for the people who grow, produce and sustain our future."

founder.quote: ODCONS PROJECTS was built around a simple belief — development should create systems that remain productive, sustainable and useful long after a project is completed.
founder.name: Anshuman Mohapatra
founder.para1: Under the leadership of Founder Anshuman Mohapatra, ODCONS PROJECTS was established to bridge the gap between high-level policy planning and ground-level execution in agricultural, aquatic and watershed landscapes.
founder.para2: By respecting traditional wisdom while introducing precision telemetry, scientific seed and feed protocols and durable infrastructure, ODCONS delivers measurable, verifiable outcomes for smallholder farmers and fishing communities across India.
founder.portraitReady: Founder portrait will be displayed here when supplied by the project owner.

about.title: Engineering Sustainable Rural Futures
about.subtitle: Founded by {founder}, ODCONS PROJECTS is dedicated to building agricultural, aquatic and watershed systems that grow beyond today.
about.vision: To be India's premier integrated technology and project execution platform across Agriculture, Fisheries, Aquaculture and Soil-Water conservation — restoring natural ecosystems while maximizing rural economic productivity.
about.mission: Deploy turn-key climate-resilient infrastructure, precise IoT telemetry, scientific feed/seed protocols and direct market aggregation to double the net household income of smallholders and fisherfolk.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.para1: ODCONS PROJECTS collects only the information you choose to share through our contact and project enquiry forms: your name, organization, email, phone and project details.
privacy.para2: We use this information solely to respond to your enquiry, evaluate your project request and communicate about ODCONS PROJECTS services. We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.
privacy.para3: If no live database or email service is configured, form submissions are stored only in your browser for demo purposes and are not transmitted anywhere.
privacy.contactUs: For privacy questions, contact us at info@odconsprojects.org.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.para1: The content on this website is provided for general information about ODCONS PROJECTS and its services. While we work hard to keep it accurate, we do not guarantee completeness or suitability for any particular purpose.
terms.para2: Illustrative project examples and metrics are shown as placeholders until verified by ODCONS PROJECTS. They do not constitute verified claims or guarantees of results.
terms.para3: By submitting a project enquiry, you agree that we may contact you using the details provided to discuss your request.
